chapter29.source_phrase: τοῖς ιβ μησὶν ἐφʼ ἑκάστου ἐνιαυτοῦ συλλαμβάνουσι καὶ τὴν πενθήμερον
chapter29.rendered_interpretation: The edited Greek text expressly adds a five-day period to twelve months of each year.
chapter29.P2_apparatus_note: A 14th-century marginal corrector reiterates including the five days in the division (p201 apparatus line 31).
chapter29.status: 365-day-year is textually supported as a possible framework for II29; printed rows still deviate and no one uniform corrected algorithm has been established

chapter36.P_apparatus_note: post κεῖνται add. ἡμέρας τξε δʼ P
chapter36.note_interpretation: Manuscript P is reported to append a 365-day figure; exact syntax not reconstructed.
chapter36.open: Do not assume II29's five-day addition fully explains II36's 52/57 emendation or all subparts.
